items.description: A 3D spatial layer stack with receding perspective depth, progressive focal blurs, and pointer parallax motion.

items.name: DirectionalTooltip
items.description: A tooltip that appears from the direction it originates — it starts a small distance outside the trigger in its preferred direction and springs inward, so it feels like it materializes from the trigger.

items.name: Donut Chart
items.description: A hand-written SVG donut and half-ring gauge with animated arcs, a live center readout, hover highlighting, and a legend that filters slices without collapsing the ring.

items.name: Dot Field
items.description: High-performance lightweight static Canvas dot matrix background with dynamic gradient coloring and responsive density scaling.

items.name: Dot Shader
items.description: A GPU-accelerated interactive dot matrix background shader with magnetic cursor repulsion, proximity illumination glow, dynamic lens scaling, and ambient wave motion.

items.name: Drag to Confirm
items.description: A minimalist physical drag-to-confirm slider for high-stakes and destructive actions, equipped with progressive track fill physics, spring snapback resistance, full light/dark theme adaptation, and accessible keyboard controls.

items.name: DrawCheckbox
items.description: A checkbox whose checkmark draws itself (path length animation) and settles with a tiny overshoot. The box scales from 0.9 -> 1.04 -> 1.0 for a tactile snap feel.

items.name: Dynamic Island
items.description: A physical morphing island component that smoothly transitions between a compact indicator, interactive summary, profile card, and social dock with spring physics.

items.name: Earnings
items.description: An earnings summary card that counts up the total, plots a scrubable trend line, and breaks income down by source with a hoverable split bar and a 7D / 30D / 12M period switcher. Light and dark themes, fully responsive.

items.name: Evil Eye
items.description: A hanging navy amulet disc with concentric sky-blue and white rings that swings with realistic inertia in response to the pointer, painted as a layered SVG and driven by a single spring pipeline.

items.name: Expandable Data Row
items.description: A polished table component with fluid accordion row unfolding, revealing deep metadata, audit activity feeds, and quick actions, with automatic card restructuring on mobile viewports.

items.name: Expandable Search
items.description: A compact search pill that smoothly widens on focus with shortcut hint pills and clear button.

items.name: FAQ
items.description: An expandable accordion FAQ component with smooth spring height calculation, single/multi-open modes, category filtering, search, and full ARIA keyboard accessibility.

items.name: Floating Action Dock
items.description: A floating quick-action toolbar inspired by macOS dock physics with smooth magnification and subtle tooltips.

items.name: Focus Mode
items.description: An atmospheric focus-mode interaction that isolates selected cards or sections by smoothly dimming surrounding distractions with zero layout shift, tactile spring scaling, and Escape key dismissal.

items.name: Form
items.description: A modular, composable form system with accessible inputs, textareas, custom selects, checkboxes, radio groups, switches, and animated validation messages.

items.name: Funnel Chart
items.description: A conversion funnel with per-stage widths, curved drop-off bridges, and a loss chip between every stage. An optional summary line reports overall conversion and the single biggest drop-off, all in hand-written SVG.

items.name: Glass Navbar
items.description: A modern, responsive glassmorphic navbar with smooth spring navigation pills, mobile menu drawer, and keyboard accessibility.

items.name: Glitch Text
items.description: A multi-modal cybernetic glitch typography component featuring 5 distinct animation variants (RGB split chromatic aberration, cyberpunk clip-slicing, analog VHS tracking loss, matrix rune scramble decode, and electrical voltage surge).

items.name: Glyph Matrix
items.description: A high-performance, canvas-driven Matrix digital rain background effect featuring streaming Katakana and numeric glyphs, glowing head highlights, decaying phosphor trails, and interactive cursor disturbances.

items.name: Gooey Menu
items.description: A tactile liquid dropdown menu with organic SVG metaball fusion filter and spring-driven extrusion animation.

items.name: Gravity Particle Burst
items.description: A pointer-triggered canvas particle burst with velocity, gravity, friction, and short-lived physical follow-through.

items.name: Hamburger Menu
items.description: An iconic three-line menu toggle that transforms smoothly into a symmetrical close symbol.

items.name: Interactive Area Chart
items.description: A hand-written, dependency-free interactive SVG area chart with interruptible dataset morphing, Catmull-Rom spline resampling, scrubbing tooltip, and keyboard accessibility.

items.name: Interactive Timeline
items.description: A developer-focused milestone and deployment timeline featuring dynamic progress lines, pulsating status nodes, expandable telemetry cards, and commit hash copy.

items.name: Intro Loader
items.description: An Apple-inspired multilingual welcome splash and intro loader that rapidly cycles localized greetings with fluid blur transitions, progress tracking, and accessible skip controls.

items.name: iOS-style Search Bar
items.description: A minimalist search pill that smoothly expands on focus and reveals quick-clear controls with spring animation.

items.name: Liquid Ripple Button
items.description: A tactile button whose pointer-origin ripple and subtle wave layer make press feedback feel fluid.

items.name: Liquid Toggle
items.description: A toggle with a liquid/blob-like transition. The internal shape deforms organically as it travels from off to on — stretching along the travel axis and settling into a natural blob shape rather than simply translating.

items.name: Live Line Chart
items.description: A real-time line chart that scrolls right-to-left, with a large current-value readout, a live delta, and a pause control. Hover or touch the chart to freeze the stream and scrub it with a crosshair tooltip.

items.name: Loader
items.description: A minimal, purpose-driven loading indicator with 4 calm, non-anxious motion variants.

items.name: LockInput
items.description: A text input whose focus state subtly "locks" into place — a focus ring scales in from the center and the border tweens to active, giving the impression that the input snaps closed on itself.

items.name: Login
items.description: A production-ready authentication card built with the EasyUI form system, featuring password show/hide, remember me, validation states, and social logins.

items.name: macOS Folder Cards
items.description: An authentic porcelain-white macOS Finder folder icon that unrolls interactive cards with fluid Apple spring physics.

items.name: Magnetic Button
items.description: A responsive button with subtle proximity-based physics that pulls towards the cursor on hover and snaps back on departure.

items.name: Meteors
items.description: A lightweight, highly aesthetic animated meteor shower effect that streams diagonal glowing celestial light beams across cards, badges, hero containers, and call-to-action sections.

items.name: Metric HUD
items.description: An interactive developer telemetry card featuring hardware-accelerated SVG sparklines, pointer-scrubbing point inspection, spring-animated time range morphing, and delta indicators.

items.name: Money Card
items.description: An interactive financial wallet card featuring animated live balance updates, quick-send contact shortcuts, recent transaction history, and responsive modal sheets for sending, receiving, and viewing activity.

items.name: Morphing Blob
items.description: An ambient, accessible SVG blob background that continuously morphs with spring physics and subtly follows the cursor for a fluid, interactive visual effect.

items.name: Morphing Button
items.description: A layout-stable interactive action button that smoothly transitions between Idle, Loading, Success, and Error states without jarring jumps or dimension shifts.

items.name: Morphing Dialog
items.description: An expandable card trigger that fluidly morphs into a centered dialog without jarring popup animations.

items.name: Morphing Icon
items.description: An animated micro-interaction wrapper that smoothly morphs between two icon states with coordinated rotation, scale, and cross-fade transitions.

items.name: Morphing Mega Menu
items.description: A Stripe-inspired mega menu with a single continuous morphing panel that smoothly adapts its size, position, and arrow to any trigger.

items.name: Morphing Shape Loader
items.description: A loading indicator that continuously morphs between configurable SVG shapes via real path interpolation. The transition is a genuine geometric morph — never a fade out / in.

items.name: Neon Edge Button
items.description: A button with a restrained light source travelling around the border while the label remains primary.

items.name: Nimbu Mirchi
items.description: A hanging lemon-and-green-chilli charm that swings with realistic inertia in response to the pointer, built from layered physical springs rather than a single rigid illustration.

items.name: Not Found
items.description: A minimal, production-ready 404 / route error component featuring floating spring-physics proximity displacement on individual glyphs, clear typography hierarchy, and accessible recovery actions.

items.name: Notification Bell
items.description: An interactive notification trigger with animated badge counter, arrival shake feedback, and dropdown panel.

items.name: Notification Stack
items.description: A stacked notification card system with physical spring stacking elevation, swipe-to-dismiss drag, and simulation triggers.

items.name: Orbital Loading Ring
items.description: A lightweight loading indicator with layered rings and orbiting particles that communicate active processing.

items.name: OriginDropdown
items.description: A dropdown with origin-aware expansion — the menu materializes from the chosen side with a slight scale and an inward translation, so its perceived origin is the trigger edge closest to the menu.

items.name: OTP Input
items.description: An accessible one-time-passcode input made of auto-advancing digit boxes, each with a spring-driven pop animation on entry, built with Framer Motion and Tailwind CSS.

items.name: Package Box
items.description: A pure CSS 3D cardboard package box featuring interactive tape-splitting physics, flap-folding choreography, and an animated packing slip that rises out and turns to face the viewer.

items.name: Particle Delete
items.description: Premium physics-driven particle dissolution delete animation that rasterizes components into thousands of authentic tiny pixels and disperses them smoothly before state removal.

items.name: Payment Receipt Printer
items.description: An animated payment and order receipt printer component for React featuring realistic thermal paper extrusion, chassis micro-vibration, customizable receipt itemization, and replay controls.

items.name: Payment Status
items.description: A calm, Apple-grade payment confirmation card with animated SVG path checkmark drawing, staged verification lifecycle transitions, receipt inspection, and failure recovery.

items.name: Peek Card
items.description: An origin-anchored contextual preview popover that emerges directly from target triggers on hover or tap with smart collision edge detection and rich metadata summaries.

items.name: Photo Box
items.description: Tactile Japanese stationery-inspired photo box featuring frosted glass translucency, sliding paper box mechanics, fanning polaroid prints, and full-bleed image zoom.

items.name: Pill Navigation
items.description: A restrained segmented navigation control with shared pill layout morphing and nested submenu dropdown support.

items.name: PressButton
items.description: A button that compresses slightly on press and settles with a tiny natural overshoot for a tactile, physical feel.

items.name: Pricing
items.description: A minimal two-tier pricing component for EasyUI. Native to the existing design system, fully theme-aware, with a quiet Free tier and a slightly more attractive Pro tier — without resorting to SaaS marketing tropes.

items.name: Product Tour
items.description: An interactive product walkthrough with spring-animated spotlight cutout, auto-scrolling targets, responsive bottom-sheet docking, and keyboard navigation.

items.name: Profile Card
items.description: A premium dark social profile card with a painted blue cover-art panel, action row, and a detail panel with avatar, verified name, bio, follower stats, and outbound website link.

items.name: Pull to Refresh
items.description: A physical pull-to-refresh component and container featuring realistic elastic resistance curves, smooth cubic bezier line chart visualization with interactive point scrubbing, high/low metrics, and seamless light & dark mode compatibility.

items.name: Rainbow Button
items.description: A vibrant button featuring an animated chromatic rainbow gradient border, dynamic 3D surface reflections, and an ambient blurred rainbow underglow.

items.name: Recovery Ledger
items.description: An archival audit timeline and state recovery ledger with chronological snapshot markers, diff inspection, and one-click rollback triggers.

items.name: Reveal Card
items.description: A high-definition product card with smooth cursor-driven 3D perspective rotation, dynamic glare, and revealed content.

items.name: Rocket Party Popper
items.description: An interactive black rocket launch that blasts into a colorful party popper confetti shower to reveal celebratory milestones.

items.name: Scroll Progress Navigation
items.description: A floating table-of-contents navigation pill that tracks scroll depth, dynamically morphs between resting and floating states, highlights active sections, and enables smooth scrolling.

items.name: Scroll Velocity Text
items.description: A direction-aware kinetic typography component that smoothly expands letter-spacing and scale on downward scroll, and winds back on upward scroll, with zero per-frame React re-renders.

items.name: Selection Basket
items.description: A floating bulk-action toolbar that smoothly rises from the bottom of the screen when multiple dataset items are selected, supporting batch operations, horizontal scrolling, and clear triggers.

items.name: SettleModal
items.description: A modal whose content has a tiny scale/settle instead of a generic fade. The panel scales 0.94 -> 1.02 -> 1.0 with a small y travel, then the inner content layers its own gentle settle on top.

items.name: Sheet
items.description: A draggable sheet / drawer that slides in from any side and can be dragged away to dismiss — swipe left/right sheets anywhere on touch, top/bottom sheets via the grab handle. Springs back if you let go early.

items.name: Shooting Stars
items.description: A high-performance deep-space cosmos background featuring multi-depth twinkling celestial stars, glowing atmospheric nebula clouds, and cinematic shooting stars with luminous head flares, tapered fading trails, ember stardust, and click-to-summon interactivity.

items.name: Sidebar
items.description: A collapsible application sidebar with a hover pill that follows the cursor and a shared-layout active pill that glides between items. Includes nested sections, icon-only mode with tooltips, ⌘B toggle, and a draggable mobile drawer.

items.name: Sign Up
items.description: A comprehensive registration card with live password strength metrics, password confirmation matching, terms validation, and social onboarding.

items.name: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder blocks with a subtle light sweep, text/avatar presets, and a SkeletonReveal container that eases real content in with a gentle rise and un-blur.

items.name: SlidePagination
items.description: A pagination control where the active indicator slides between pages rather than instantly switching. The active background uses shared layoutId so the indicator visibly travels from one item to the next.

items.name: Small Floating Dock
items.description: A minimal, gesture-responsive floating dock for quick access to 3-5 primary actions.

items.name: Smart Comparison
items.description: An interactive feature matrix and SaaS tier comparison component featuring live difference filtering, collapsible specification categories, search indexing, and mobile card toggle.

items.name: Smooth Accordion
items.description: An accordion component with physics height transition, rotating chevron indicators, and accessible keyboard toggles.

items.name: Sparkles Core
items.description: A high-performance, zero-dependency particle sparkle canvas with multi-shape geometry (circles, radiant diamond stars, cross starlets), organic twinkling, interactive cursor repulsion/attraction, click particle bursts, and fluid SSR safety.

items.name: Speed Warp
items.description: A 3D perspective canvas starfield simulation that projects relativistic light streaks toward the viewer, creating an intense hyperspace or warp drive velocity effect.

items.name: Split Button
items.description: A primary action fused with a chevron trigger that reveals related actions in a spring-timed dropdown, sharing a single pill silhouette.

items.name: Spotlight Card
items.description: A dark elevated surface that illuminates border and inner surfaces dynamically based on mouse pointer coordinates.

items.name: Spotlight Search
items.description: A global command palette and search overlay triggered by ⌘K featuring real-time fuzzy filtering, moving active highlight springs, kbd shortcuts, and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: SpringSelect
items.description: A select dropdown whose menu follows the trigger with a tiny spring. The chevron rotates a hair past 180° before settling, and the panel slides down with a subtle overshoot.

items.name: Stack Unfold Panel
items.description: A vertically stacked card deck that unfolds progressively with spring physics, shifting adjacent panels with zero layout jank.

items.name: Stacked Cards
items.description: A responsive, scroll-driven stacking cards component built with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. Cards start aligned in a column and stack gracefully on scroll without hijacking page scrolling.

items.name: Stat Card
items.description: A KPI tile with a count-up headline number, a direction-aware delta pill, and a scrubable sparkline. Pair several with StatGrid for a responsive metrics row that works from phones to wide dashboards.

items.name: Stepper
items.description: A multi-step progress indicator with line fills, gliding active rings, drawing checkmarks, and direction-aware sliding step panels.

items.name: Sticky Pages
items.description: A pure static full-page sticky stacking scroll component where pages slide up and stack cleanly one over another without any tilting or distortion, before releasing smoothly into natural page scrolling.

items.name: Story Cards
items.description: A responsive, accessible story cards carousel for React applications built with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion.

items.name: StretchSwitch
items.description: A toggle switch whose thumb stretches slightly while dragging or pressing, then snaps naturally to its destination via a snappy spring.

items.name: Text Scramble Decoder
items.description: A controlled text reveal that resolves scrambled glyphs into readable copy without changing the text semantics.

items.name: Thème Easy UI
items.description: Tokens (couleurs clair/sombre, typographie, rayons) extraits de src/styles/tokens.css + src/styles/index.css. Les styles propres au site d'origine sont exclus.

items.name: Thinking Orb
items.description: Minimalist monochrome spherical particle vortex with orbital physics, pure black-and-white luminous styling, and 9 cognitive state deformations.

items.name: Torque Dial
items.description: A rotational control dial with realistic physical angular momentum, velocity tracking, and exponential friction deceleration.

items.name: Typewriter Button
items.description: An interactive button that reveals its label character-by-character with optional synthesized mechanical audio feedback.

items.name: Undo Toast
items.description: An advanced undo notification toast featuring an interactive progress countdown, pause-on-hover mechanics, action reversal animation, and versatile position anchoring.

items.name: UnfoldAccordion
items.description: An accordion whose content unfolds with the chevron and spacing moving together. The chevron rotates 180° while the content height expands and the inner content slides up to close the gap, producing a single, fluid motion.

items.name: VelocityToast
items.description: A toast that enters with velocity and settles, with a progress indicator that responds naturally — pauses on hover, resumes with no jump, and eases slightly in the final 10% so dismissal feels intentional.

items.name: Wallet Balance
items.description: An interactive wallet balance component where branded cards tuck neatly into an embossed leather pouch with spring physics. Tap the eye button to reveal or mask balances with smooth blur-crossfade transitions.

items.name: Wallet Card
items.description: A premium dark wallet card with a blue radial-gradient surface, live balance display, iOS-style toggle, and a primary action button. The card surface responds to the pointer with a soft cyan shine driven entirely by MotionValues.

items.name: Alert
items.description: A message set into the page that stays until it is dealt with, as a card in a tray of its tone.

items.name: Alert Dialog
items.description: A question that must be answered before the page can be used again, with the answers side by side under it.

items.name: Avatar
items.description: A person or a team as a picture, or their initials in a colour of their own, with a badge and a group that opens up.

items.name: Badge
items.description: A short label for a state or a kind, tinted in its theme colour, with a dot for a state that is still changing.

items.name: Bar Picker
items.description: A short run of values as columns of lights, one column picked.

items.name: Button
items.description: Something to press, in the weight its action deserves, with a spinner for while it works.

items.name: Button Group
items.description: Related buttons joined into one control, with separators, text cells and fields between them.

items.name: Canvas
items.description: A surface of dots, lines or crosses for other components to sit on, with a light that can follow the pointer.

items.name: Card
items.description: A surface that holds one thing, with a heading, an action beside it and a footer.

items.name: Checkbox
items.description: One choice that is on or off, with a tick that draws itself and a parent box for a group.

items.name: Chip
items.description: A pill that can be pressed: a filter turned on and off, or an added value with a × to take it out.

items.name: Choice Cards
items.description: One option chosen from a few, each shown as a picture of what it does.

items.name: Command
items.description: A launcher: type to find a page, an app or an action, and run it with Enter.

items.name: Command Dock
items.description: A small button that opens into a field, with the answer arriving under it a row at a time.

items.name: Day Grid
items.description: A run of days as a field of dots, each sized by how much happened on it.

items.name: Dialog
items.description: A task done in a panel over the page, with its buttons in the band beneath it.

items.name: Feedback
items.description: A dialog with a well to write in and two actions in the band around it.

items.name: Field
items.description: A form control with its label, a line of help and its error, wired to each other.

items.name: Flow
items.description: A canvas of nodes joined by edges, that you pan, zoom and rearrange.

items.name: Frame
items.description: A panel of rows set into a tray, with the tray's top strip carrying the title.

items.name: Input
items.description: A single line to type into, with icons, units and buttons set inside its box.

items.name: Inspector
items.description: The settings panel beside an editor's canvas: a rail of icons, each opening a page of titled sections.

items.name: KPI
items.description: One number and what it is doing: its change, its shape over time, its progress to a target.

items.name: Label
items.description: The name of a field, with its required mark, a hint and an action on one line.

items.name: Lane Board
items.description: Lanes of cards that can be dragged within a lane and from one lane to another.

items.name: Menu
items.description: A list of actions that opens from a button, with shortcuts, checks and submenus.

items.name: Message
items.description: One turn of a conversation with an assistant: a person's bubble, or an answer set as prose with actions under it.

items.name: Model Picker
items.description: A select for the model a message goes to, searched by name, filtered by provider and starred.

items.name: Not Found
items.description: An error code drawn in pixels that come apart near the pointer, with a title and a way out.

items.name: Planet
items.description: The world as dots on a globe you can turn, with markers pinned to it.

items.name: Prompt
items.description: A field for writing to an assistant, with its files, model and tools in one card.

items.name: Radio Group
items.description: One choice from a short list, with every option visible and the arrow keys moving between them.

items.name: Range Meter
items.description: A reading on a ruler of ticks that rises where the value is, with the number above it.

items.name: Rolling Number
items.description: A number whose digits roll to their new values.

items.name: Select
items.description: A button that opens a list of options and shows the one chosen.
